buildCommand:
rm -rf apps/router-api apps/verifier && echo 'packages:
  - "apps/dashboard"
  - "packages/*"' > pnpm-workspace.yaml && npx pnpm@latest install && cd apps/dashboard && pnpm build
installCommand:
rm -rf apps/router-api apps/verifier && echo 'packages:
  - "apps/dashboard"
  - "packages/*"' > pnpm-workspace.yaml && npx pnpm@latest install
